input.summary: Apify tools were unavailable, so I used only web_search and fetch_and_segment. The corpus is about 195 relevant Dutch documents, just under the 200 target. Almost all come from FOK forum threads on chips, borrelnoten and healthy tussendoortjes, plus a few from happyhealthy.nl comments and an ouders.nl supermarket thread. Strong coverage: RQ-01 (about 102 relevant docs) and RQ-02 (about 108), mainly complaints about Lay's reformulation, less salt and changing borrelnoot flavours. Moderate: RQ-03 (44), RQ-04 (45), RQ-05 (29) and RQ-06 (25). RQ-07 has almost nothing. The discussion skews toward older threads and forum-heavy, older users. TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and Kieskeurig could not be reached, so HYP-04 (discovery through TikTok and YouTube) is untested.

source_verdicts.reason: Main source: first-person Dutch threads on chips brands, borrelnoten, healthy snacks; 56% relevant.
Reader comments on healthy tussendoortjes, relevant to RQ-03.
First-person comments on Lidl, Aldi, Jumbo and AH quality and price, relevant to RQ-04.
One relevant protein-bar passage; low volume.
Expat posts fell outside the time window; nothing kept.
Tourist posts, not relevant to Dutch consumers.

gaps: RQ-07 (vegan, glutenvrij, high protein, low sugar demand) has almost no evidence; the vegan and glutenvrij pages were inaccessible.
RQ-06 (discovery and repurchase) is thin, and there is no TikTok/YouTube voice, so HYP-04 is untested.
Younger voices (18-30) are underrepresented; the corpus skews toward older FOK forum threads.
No Reddit or Kieskeurig content could be collected, and bokt.nl and the Radar forum were inaccessible.
The expat voice is essentially absent.
Sustainability and packaging (HYP-05) and online purchasing are barely covered.
The corpus is slightly under the 200 relevant document target.
